rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: Abu Hurayra reports that the Prophet said everything was created from water, then prescribed greeting people, feeding them, keeping kin ties and night prayer as deeds leading to peaceful entry into Paradise.
rows.anchor: فقال: " كل شيء خلق من ماء "

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: Abu Hurayra reports that the Prophet said everything was created from water, then prescribed greeting people, kind speech, keeping kin ties and night prayer as deeds leading to peaceful entry into Paradise.
rows.anchor: فقال: " كل شيء خلق من ماء "

rows.speaker: عائشة
rows.claim: Aisha reports clear dreams preceded Muhammad’s worship at Hira; Gabriel’s three squeezes led to reciting al-ʿAlaq 96:1–5. Khadija consoled him citing virtues; Waraqa identified Gabriel as Moses’s messenger and predicted opposition; after a reported pause, Gabriel reassured him.
rows.anchor: عن عائشة أنها قالت: " أول ما بدئ به رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas reports that Abu Jahl tried to stop Muhammad praying and boasted of his council; al-ʿAlaq 96:10–13 was revealed, and Ibn Abbas says angels would seize him if he summoned them.
rows.anchor: عن ابن عباس، قال: " جاء أبو جهل إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: أبو هريرة
rows.claim: Abu Hurayra reports Abu Jahl threatened Muhammad praying, then retreated, claiming fire and wings barred him; Muhammad said angels would seize him. In al-ʿAlaq, Abu Jahl is the denier, his people the council, angels the zabāniya; revelation attribution is uncertain.
rows.anchor: عن أبي هريرة، قال: قال أبو جهل: هل يعفر محمد وجهه بين أظهركم؟
